title: Enhancing Safety of Large Language Models via Embedding Space Separation
abstract: arXiv:2603.20206v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Safety alignment does not fully prevent large language models (LLMs) from producing harmful content under adversarial attacks. We observe that existing attack methods typically move harmful embeddings toward regions of harmless embeddings. This motivates us to explore whether increasing the distance between harmful and harmless embeddings can improve the safety of LLMs, since greater separation requires attacks to make larger embedding shifts, which can destroy semantics. We propose Embedding Space Separation (ES2), a fine-tuning method that increases the distance between harmful and harmless embeddings. However, maximizing this distance alone can damage LLMs' capabilities. Thus, we use two regularization losses: an embedding anchor loss keeps harmless embeddings close in direction to those of a frozen base model and a KL-divergence loss keeps output distributions on harmless prompts close to those of the base model. translated_title: 通过嵌入空间分离增强大语言模型的安全性
translated_abstract: 安全对齐并不能完全防止大语言模型在对抗性攻击下产生有害内容。我们观察到，现有的攻击方法通常会将有害嵌入移动至无害嵌入所在的区域。这促使我们探索增大有害嵌入与无害嵌入之间的距离是否能够提高大语言模型的安全性，因为更大的分离距离意味着攻击需要造成更大的嵌入偏移，而这会破坏语义。我们提出了嵌入空间分离（ES2），这是一种能够增大有害嵌入与无害嵌入之间距离的微调方法。然而，仅仅最大化这一距离可能会损害大语言模型的能力。因此，我们采用了两种正则化损失：嵌入锚定损失使无害嵌入在方向上与冻结的基础模型保持接近，KL散度损失使无害提示上的输出分布与基础模型的输出分布保持接近。我们的实验……
tldr: 提出ES2微调方法，通过增大有害与无害嵌入之间的距离来增强大语言模型对抗性攻击的安全性，并利用嵌入锚定损失和KL散度损失两种正则化手段来保持模型的原始能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ES2, a fine-tuning method that enhances LLM safety against adversarial attacks by increasing the distance between harmful and harmless embeddings, while preserving model capabilities through embedding anchor and KL-divergence regularization losses.
